embezzlement: The accountant was arrested for embezzlement after stealing money from the company for years.
会计因多年来贪污公司资金而被逮捕。
antiquated: The school's antiquated computers were finally replaced with new machines last summer.
学校里过时的电脑终于在去年夏天被换成了新机器。
roll film: Photographers used roll film before digital cameras became popular in the market.
在数码相机流行之前,摄影师们使用胶卷。
fumes: She opened all the windows to let the poisonous fumes escape from the kitchen.
她打开所有的窗户,让厨房里的有毒气体散出去。
laterality: Doctors studied the child's laterality to determine which hand he preferred to use.
医生研究孩子的偏侧性,以确定他习惯用哪只手。
treatise: The professor wrote a long treatise on modern economic theory last year.
教授去年写了一篇关于现代经济理论的长篇专著。
overgraze: Farmers must move their sheep often so the animals do not overgraze the land.
农民必须经常转移羊群,以免牲口过度啃食牧地。
estrange: His rude behavior began to estrange him from his closest friends.
他的粗鲁行为开始使他与最亲密的朋友疏远。
judicious: Making judicious decisions about money will help you avoid serious debt problems.
对金钱做出明智的决定会帮助你避免严重的债务问题。
feminism: She became interested in feminism after reading books about women's rights.
她在读了关于女性权利的书籍后对女权主义产生了兴趣。
maximise: The company changed its advertising plan to maximise sales during the holiday season.
公司调整了广告计划,以便在假日期间使销售额最大化。
courtship: During their long courtship, they wrote letters to each other every week.
在漫长的求爱期里,他们每周都互相写信。
reinvigorate: A short holiday by the sea will reinvigorate you after months of hard work.
在海边度个短假,会让你在数月辛苦工作之后恢复活力。
ape: The ape in the zoo amused visitors by copying everything they did.
动物园里的猿模仿游客的一举一动,逗乐了大家。
modish: She always wears modish clothes that she buys from the city's fashion stores.
她总是穿着从城里时装店买来的时髦衣服。
aeronautics: My brother studies aeronautics at university because he dreams of designing aircraft.
我哥哥在大学学习航空学,因为他梦想设计飞机。
deplete: Using too much water every day will deplete the town's supply quickly.
每天用水过多会很快耗尽城镇的供水。
grimy: After working in the coal mine all day, his hands were grimy.
在煤矿工作了一整天之后,他的双手积满了污垢。
tribal: The museum displayed tribal masks collected from villages across the African continent.
博物馆展出了从非洲大陆各村寨收集来的部落面具。
asymmetry: There was a slight asymmetry between the two sides of the old building.
这座古建筑的两侧有轻微的不对称。
bilateral: The two countries signed a bilateral agreement to trade goods without extra taxes.
两国签署了一项双边协定,商品贸易免征额外关税。
foreland: The ship sailed past the rocky foreland just before the storm arrived.
就在暴风雨来临之前,船驶过了多岩石的岬角。
climatic: Scientists warn that climatic changes could affect farming in many regions.
科学家警告说,气候变化可能影响许多地区的农业。
guinea: He paid thirty guineas for the antique clock at the small shop.
他花了三十几尼在这家小店里买下了那座古董钟。
symbolism: The teacher explained the symbolism of the white dove in the poem.
老师解释了诗中白鸽的象征意义。
jeopardise: Driving so fast in the rain will jeopardise your safety and others'.
雨天开车这么快会危及你和他人的安全。
utilisation: The effective utilisation of solar energy can reduce household electricity bills greatly.
有效利用太阳能可以大大减少家庭电费开支。
aggressiveness: His aggressiveness on the football field sometimes leads to unnecessary fouls.
他在足球场上的攻击性有时会导致不必要的犯规。
congested: The streets were so congested that we missed the beginning of the film.
街道拥挤不堪,以致我们错过了电影的开头。
optic: The optic nerve carries images from the eye to the brain.
视神经把图像从眼睛传送到大脑。
biometrics: Many phones now use biometrics, such as fingerprints, to unlock the screen.
现在许多手机使用指纹等生物识别技术来解锁屏幕。
flexitime: The company offers flexitime, so employees can start work between eight and ten.
公司实行弹性工作制,员工可以在八点到十点之间开始上班。
decouple: The government wants to decouple economic growth from rising pollution levels.
政府希望使经济增长与不断加剧的污染脱钩。
helix: The DNA molecule has the shape of a double helix, like a twisted ladder.
DNA分子呈双螺旋结构,像一个扭曲的梯子。
apportion: The teacher will apportion the tasks among the students in small groups.
老师将把任务分派给各小组的学生。
hereditary: The crown passed to the young prince through hereditary right.
王位按世袭权利传给了年轻的王子。
adjunct: The new library is an adjunct to the school's main teaching building.
新图书馆是学校主教学楼的附属建筑。
despoil: Wars in the past often despoiled the countryside and left villages in ruins.
过去的战争常常蹂躏乡村,使村庄沦为废墟。
consulate: You must apply for a visa at the consulate before travelling abroad.
出国旅行之前,你必须先在领事馆申请签证。
socialise: It is important for children to socialise with others of their own age.
孩子与同龄人交往很重要。
